bootstrap_state_valid.name: bootstrap_state_valid
bootstrap_state_valid.value:
("bootstrap_state"."status" = 'empty' AND "bootstrap_state"."claim_email" IS NULL AND "bootstrap_state"."user_id" IS NULL AND "bootstrap_state"."workspace_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("bootstrap_state"."status" = 'claimed' AND "bootstrap_state"."claim_email" IS NOT NULL AND "bootstrap_state"."user_id" IS NULL AND "bootstrap_state"."workspace_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("bootstrap_state"."status" = 'complete' AND (("bootstrap_state"."user_id" IS NULL AND "bootstrap_state"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR ("bootstrap_state"."claim_email" IS NOT NULL)))

notepad_links_single_target_chk.name: notepad_links_single_target_chk
notepad_links_single_target_chk.value: num_nonnulls("notepad_links"."target_user_id", "notepad_links"."target_notepad_id", "notepad_links"."target_card_id", "notepad_links"."target_board_id") = 1 AND (("notepad_links"."target_type" = 'user' AND "notepad_links"."target_user_id" = "notepad_links"."target_id") OR ("notepad_links"."target_type" = 'notepad' AND "notepad_links"."target_notepad_id" = "notepad_links"."target_id") OR ("notepad_links"."target_type" = 'card' AND "notepad_links"."target_card_id" = "notepad_links"."target_id") OR ("notepad_links"."target_type" = 'board' AND "notepad_links"."target_board_id" = "notepad_links"."target_id"))
